title: Convert no-jump norm and survival into full-channel error
statement: If E(rho)=A rho A*+J(rho) is CP/TP on a finite logical input, W is an isometry, ||A-W||<=delta and A*A>=sI with0<=s<=1,then full-output reference-stable half-diamond(E,W)<=delta+(1-s)/2.

requires: Operator norm delta and worst-input survival s on the same logical subspace
provides: Ancilla-stable unconditional channel bound including all jump outcomes
assumptions: A is a contraction by trace preservation
Not a fidelity-to-norm conversion; all leakage outputs retained
No oscillator certificate values are acquired by this proof
costs: Requires independent acquisition of delta,s and the decomposition; no postselection discount
contract.units: Dimensionless half-diamond error and fidelity; oscillator time converts using angular frequency omega, not cycles. SI examples explicitly assume 5 GHz. Component values are model designs; losses are declared-model probabilities, not measurements.
contract.obstruction: A reported high no-jump fidelity alone supplies neither operator-norm control nor a full-output channel certificate.

input_slots.description: A genuine CP/TP full-output channel decomposition, no-jump operator error delta and minimum survival s on the same logical input.
